book.name: SAN LUCAS
book.title: SAN LUCAS Jesucristo yee Añurije Quetire Lucas cʉ̃ ca owarique

content: Oveja ca yairicʉre ĩi cõoñari Jesús cʉ̃ ca wederique
Paʉ, Roma maquẽre wapa jee bojari maja, ñañarije ca tiirã, Jesús're nea poo eaupa cʉ̃ ca wederijere tʉorʉgarã.
O biro cʉ̃re cʉ̃ja ca biirije jʉori, fariseos, doti cũuquĩriquere ca jʉo buerã, o biro ĩi wede paiupa Jesús're: —Ania, ñañarije ca tiirãre añuro tii, cʉ̃ja menara baa, tiimi déé —ĩiupa.
To biro cʉ̃ja ca ĩiro, cʉ̃ pea ati wãme ĩi cõoñari cʉ̃jare wedeupi:
—¿Nii mʉja mena macʉ̃ pee cien ovejas ca cʉogʉ, jĩcʉ̃ cʉ̃ ca yairo, ca yairicʉre amagʉ waagʉ, noventa y nueve ca niirãre toora cũucã, cʉ̃re bʉacãripʉ cʉ̃ ama yerijãatiti?
Cʉ̃re bʉagʉ, bʉaro ʉjea niirique mena cʉ̃re ami pʉja,
cʉ̃ yaa wii tua eagʉ, cʉ̃ mena macãrãre, cʉ̃ ca niiri tabe macãrãre, jʉo neo, o biro ĩicumi: “Yʉ mena ʉjea niiña. Mee, yʉ oveja ca yairicʉre yʉ bʉajãwʉ,” ĩicumi.

To biiri wãmera bii ʉmʉreco tutipʉre: Jĩcʉ̃ ñañarije ca tiigʉ cʉ̃ ca tʉgoeña yeri wajoaro, mee añurã noventa y nueve ca niirã ca tʉgoeña yeri wajoarique bootirã menare ʉjea niiricaro ametʉenero ʉjea niirique nii —cʉ̃jare ĩi wedeupi Jesús.
Wapa tiirica tii ca yairiquere cʉ̃ ca ĩi cõoña wederique
—¿Dico ʉno nomio wapa tiirica tiiri, pʉa amo cõro niiri tiiri ca cʉogo, jĩcã tii ca yairo, jĩa boericaga mena jĩa boeri, to cãnacã tabepʉra añuro owa ama, tii tiire bʉacãripʉ cõ ama yerijãatiti?
Tii tiire bʉago, cõ mena macãrã romirire, cõ ca niiri tabe pʉto macãrãre, o biro ĩicumo: “Yʉ mena ʉjea niiña. Mee, yʉ wapa tiirica tii, ca yairica tiire yʉ bʉajãwʉ,” cʉ̃jare ĩicumo.
To biri wãmera ʉjea niirique nii Ʉmʉreco Pacʉ pʉto macãrãre, jĩcʉ̃ ñañarije ca tiigʉ cʉ̃ ca tʉgoeña yeri wajoaro —cʉ̃jare ĩiupi.
Cʉ̃ macʉ̃ ca yairicʉre, cʉ̃ pacʉ cʉ̃ ca bʉariquere cʉ̃ ca ĩi cõoñarique
O biro cʉ̃jare ĩi wedeupi ñucã Jesús: —Jĩcʉ̃, pʉarã puna cʉtiupʉ.
Ca bai pee o biro ĩiupʉ cʉ̃ pacʉre: “Cáacʉ, yʉ yee ca niipe mʉ ca cʉorijere yʉre tiicojoya,” ĩiupʉ. To biro cʉ̃ ca ĩiro, pʉarãpʉrena cʉ̃jare dica woocãupʉ.

”No cãnacã rʉmʉ jiro mééra, ca bai pea, cʉ̃ pacʉ cʉ̃ ca dica wooriquere jee neo, ape yepapʉ, ca yoaropʉ, waacoaupʉ. Toopʉ, noo ca boorora tii niima ĩigʉ, cʉ̃ yee, cʉ̃ pacʉ cʉ̃ ca dica woomiriquere tii bate peoticãupʉ.
Cʉ̃ ca jee waamiriquere cʉ̃ ca tii bate peotiro jiro, tii yepapʉre baarique peticoaupe. To biro ca biiro, cʉ̃ pea bʉaro aʉa tamʉo jʉo waaupʉ.
To biri tii yepa macʉ̃re paderique jãigʉ waaupʉ. Cʉ̃ pea, cʉ̃ yaa wejeripʉ cʉ̃ yejeare cʉ̃re eca cote doti cojoupʉ.
Bʉaro queyama ĩigʉ, yejea cʉ̃ja ca baarijerena baarʉgamiupʉ. To biro cʉ̃ ca biicã pacaro, jĩcʉ̃ peera jĩcã wãme ʉnora cʉ̃re baarique eca, tiiticãuparã.
”Biirique peti tʉgoeña bojoca cati, o biro ĩiupʉ: —¿Yʉ pacʉre pade coteri maja paʉ baarique cʉ̃ja ca cʉocãro, yʉ pea anopʉ yʉ aʉa boa duwi yujuti?
Yʉ pacʉ pʉtopʉra tua waari, o biro cʉ̃re yʉ ĩirucu: “Cáacʉ, Ʉmʉreco Pacʉ menare, mʉ menare ñañarijere yʉ tiijapa.
To biri ‘Yʉ macʉ̃,’ yʉre ĩiticãña. Jĩcʉ̃ mʉre ca pade coteri majʉre biro pee yʉre tiiya,” yʉ ĩirucu —ĩiupʉ.

”To biro ĩicã cʉ̃ pacʉ pʉtopʉra tuacoaupʉ ñucã. Ména yoaropʉra cʉ̃ ca niiro, cʉ̃ pacʉ pea cʉ̃re ĩa maji, cʉ̃re ĩa boo pacaupʉ. To biri cʉ̃re ũmaa boca, cʉ̃re paabario, cʉ̃ wajopuare ũpũ, cʉ̃re tiiupʉ.
To biro cʉ̃ ca tiiro, cʉ̃ macʉ̃ pea o biro cʉ̃re ĩiupʉ: “Cáacʉ, Ʉmʉreco Pacʉ menare, mʉ menare ñañarijere yʉ tiijapa. To biri, ‘Yʉ macʉ̃,’ yʉre ĩiticãña,” cʉ̃re ĩiupʉ.
”To biro cʉ̃ ca ĩi pacaro, cʉ̃ pacʉ pea cʉ̃re pade coteri majare: “Yoari méé, jutiro añurito ami doori cʉ̃re jãa, amo jũa jãarica beto cãare jãa, dʉpo juti cãare jãa, cʉ̃re tiiya.
Ñucã wecʉ añuro ca díí cʉtigʉre, ami doori, cʉ̃re jĩaña. Yʉ macʉ̃ cʉ̃ ca tua eari boje rʉmʉ mani tii ʉjea nii baaco.
Ani, yʉ macʉ̃re, ‘Bii yaicoajacupi,’ yʉ ĩi tʉgoeñarucumijãwʉ. Bii yaitijapi. Waa yaicoamiwi, cʉ̃re mani bʉa ñucã,” ĩiupʉ. To cõrora boje rʉmʉ tiicã jʉo waauparã mee yua.
”To biro cʉ̃ja ca tii niicãro, cʉ̃ macʉ̃ ca jũwʉ pea wejepʉ niiupʉ. Ca pade niiricʉ tua doogʉ, wii pʉto ea doogʉ, cʉ̃ja ca baja wedeo niirijere tʉoupʉ.
To biri jĩcʉ̃ pade coteri majʉre jʉo cojo, “¿Ñee to biijãri yua?” cʉ̃re ĩi jãiñaupʉ.

To biro cʉ̃ ca ĩiro, pade coteri majʉ pea o biro cʉ̃re ĩiupʉ: “Mʉ bai tua eajãwi. To biri mʉ pacʉ pea wecʉ añuro ca díí cʉtigʉre jĩa dotijãwi. Cʉ̃ macʉ̃re añuro ca cati añugʉrena, yʉ bʉa, ĩima ĩigʉ boje rʉmʉ tiirʉgʉ,” cʉ̃re ĩiupʉ.
”Cʉ̃ jũwʉ pea teere bʉaro tʉo ajiari, jãa waarʉgatiupʉ. To biri cʉ̃ pacʉ pea cʉ̃re jʉogʉ witi waaupʉ.

Cʉ̃ pea o biro ĩiupʉ cʉ̃ pacʉre: “Cáacʉ, paʉ cʉ̃mari, jĩcãti ʉno peera mʉre ametʉene nʉcãri méé yʉ ca pade niirijere mʉ maji. To biro yʉ ca bii pacaro, ‘Cʉ̃ mena macãrã mena cʉ̃ jĩa baajato’ ĩigʉ, jĩcʉ̃ cabra macʉ̃ ʉnoacãrena jĩcãti ʉno peera yʉre tiicojorucu, mʉ tii ñaati.

Ani mʉ macʉ̃, mʉ yeere ʉmʉa cʉ̃ja ca tii eperã romiri mena tii epe nucũ yuju, tii bate peoticãri ca tua eagʉ peera, wecʉ añuro ca díí cʉtigʉre jĩacãri, cʉ̃re mʉ boje rʉmʉ tii peo,” cʉ̃re ĩiupʉ cʉ̃ pacʉre.
”To biro cʉ̃ ca ĩiro, cʉ̃ pacʉ pea o biro cʉ̃re ĩiupʉ: “Macʉ̃, mʉa yʉ menara mʉ niicõa nii. Yʉ ca cʉorije niipetirije mʉ yee wado niiro bii.

Ani, mʉ bai, ‘Bii yaicoajacupi,’ yʉ ca ĩi tʉgoeñarucumigʉ, catijapi. Ca waa yairicʉre mani bʉa ñucã. To biri cʉ̃re ca boje rʉmʉ tii peo ʉjea niipera niiro bii,” cʉ̃re ĩiupʉ cʉ̃ pacʉ —ĩi wedeupi Jesús bojocare.
